description: Source code for CUDA implementations of 2D and 3D grid sampling functions and their backward passes in PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: grid_sampler_2d_cuda
methods.description: Performs 2D grid sampling on CUDA tensors, producing an output tensor based on input and grid.

methods.name: grid_sampler_3d_cuda
methods.description: Performs 3D grid sampling on CUDA tensors, producing an output tensor based on input and grid.

methods.name: grid_sampler_2d_backward_cuda
methods.description: Computes gradients for 2D grid sampling backward pass on CUDA tensors.

methods.name: grid_sampler_3d_backward_cuda
methods.description: Computes gradients for 3D grid sampling backward pass on CUDA tensors.
